title: Iron Roots
description: Thirty hinge-and-push intervals from the canonical Fable W1 routine.

intervals.coachNote: Ramp from easy marching to a steady pattern with relaxed arm circles; no bounce.
Begin shallow and deepen only while the heels stay down.
regressions: Use a smaller range or hold support if balance or hip range limits depth.

intervals.coachNote: Hinge from the hips with a long spine; reach without forcing range.
Prepare the ankles with pumps and heel-to-toe rocks; this is not a calf-raise station.
Stand at the wall and reach without shrugging or forcing the shoulder range.
Step side to side with relaxed arms; keep the landings quiet and planted.
Use dumbbells if stable; keep the rear instep flat (or use a folded mat under it) and breathe through the pause.
regressions: Keep the rear instep flat or use a folded mat.
Shorten the stance rather than forcing the great toe.
Use bodyweight or support if needed.

intervals.coachNote: Use dumbbells if stable; keep the rear instep flat (or use a folded mat under it) and breathe through the pause.
regressions: Keep the rear instep flat or use a folded mat.
Shorten the stance rather than forcing the great toe.
Use bodyweight or support if needed.

intervals.coachNote: Use a standard, knees-down, or hands-elevated push-up; never use fists as a toe-safe regression.
regressions: Use knees-down or hands-elevated; fists do not unload the first MTP.

intervals.coachNote: Use dumbbells with a flat back, square pelvis, and eyes on a fixed spot.
regressions: Use wall support or a toe kickstand; keep the whole foot loaded.

intervals.coachNote: Use dumbbells with a flat back, square pelvis, and eyes on a fixed spot.
regressions: Use wall support or a toe kickstand; keep the whole foot loaded.

intervals.coachNote: Use 7 kg if form stays clean; support the free hand and keep the shoulder away from the ear.
regressions: Use a lighter dumbbell or forearm support if the back or shoulder position changes.

intervals.coachNote: Use 7 kg if form stays clean; support the free hand and keep the shoulder away from the ear.
regressions: Use a lighter dumbbell or forearm support if the back or shoulder position changes.

intervals.coachNote: Keep the pelvis level while alternating the march; avoid anterior-hip pinching.
regressions: Use a bilateral bridge if marching loses pelvic control.

intervals.coachNote: Use a moderate stance width, hold the dumbbell at the chest, and keep breathing.
regressions: Use a lighter load or a higher stance without turning the hold into an aggressive hip stretch.

intervals.tempo: Slow ascent and descent; whole foot planted
intervals.coachNote: Use a low step and control the pelvis; place the whole foot on the step.
regressions: Lower the step or use a stable support; do not push off the trailing foot.

intervals.tempo: Slow ascent and descent; whole foot planted
intervals.coachNote: Use a low step and control the pelvis; place the whole foot on the step.
regressions: Lower the step or use a stable support; do not push off the trailing foot.

intervals.coachNote: Lift into a comfortable W, squeeze for two seconds, and keep the neck relaxed.
regressions: Use a smaller lift or no lift if the shoulder feels apprehensive.

intervals.coachNote: Carry 7 kg tall, switch hands at 20 seconds, and march briskly without bouncing.
regressions: Use a lighter dumbbell or reduce the knee lift while keeping the trunk tall.

intervals.coachNote: Thread one arm under the body, switch sides at 20 seconds, and rotate only through a comfortable range.
regressions: Keep the knees grounded and shorten the rotation if the shoulder or back feels strained.

intervals.coachNote: Move slowly and exhale; keep the back quiet against the floor.
regressions: Keep the feet supported or reduce the limb range if the back arches.

intervals.coachNote: Kick slowly with a controlled hold and return; keep the standing foot stable.
regressions: Use a wall for balance and lower the kick height.

intervals.coachNote: Kick slowly with a controlled hold and return; keep the standing foot stable.
regressions: Use a wall for balance and lower the kick height.

intervals.tempo: 3 s up / 1 s pause / 3 s down
intervals.coachNote: Use a dumbbell if stable; load the calf deliberately, never bounce, and keep pressure distributed across the forefoot.
regressions: Use support or a bilateral calf raise; keep pain 0–3/10 and below the 5/10 ceiling.

intervals.tempo: 3 s up / 1 s pause / 3 s down
intervals.coachNote: Use a dumbbell if stable; load the calf deliberately, never bounce, and keep pressure distributed across the forefoot.
regressions: Use support or a bilateral calf raise; keep pain 0–3/10 and below the 5/10 ceiling.

intervals.coachNote: Load the stance leg and press the inside knee into the wall for about 2 × 15 seconds while keeping the pelvis level.
regressions: Reduce wall pressure or shorten the holds if lateral-hip pain appears.

intervals.coachNote: Load the stance leg and press the inside knee into the wall for about 2 × 15 seconds while keeping the pelvis level.
regressions: Reduce wall pressure or shorten the holds if lateral-hip pain appears.

intervals.coachNote: After the warm-up, hold one 7 kg dumbbell with both hands; drive from the hips with feet planted and no heel pop.
regressions: Use a lighter load or reduce the range; never jump the weight.

intervals.coachNote: Walk briskly backward with whole-foot landings and a clear path.
regressions: Use a wall or rail for support and slow the pace.

intervals.coachNote: Use the work interval to downshift with easy reaches and calm breathing; keep the final 20-second rest.
